elements.name: new

Create a new FlexNode with initial properties.
All fields have sensible defaults; only key is typically required.

elements.name: calculate_layout
elements.brief:
Run the layout engine on a node tree without creating a Node instance.
Convenience function for callers using plain Lua table element trees.
elements.description:
Run the layout engine on a node tree without creating a Node instance.
Convenience function for callers using plain Lua table element trees.

parameters.name: root
parameters.doc: The root element tree to compute layout for

parameters.name: width
parameters.doc: Available width (falls back to numeric root.style.width or 0)

parameters.name: height
parameters.doc: Available height (falls back to numeric root.style.height or 0)

returnvalues.doc: The root element (layout written to root.layout and descendants)

functions.name: insert_child

functions.name: remove_child

Remove a child node by reference. No-op when child is not found.

functions.description:

parameters.doc: The child node to remove (matched by reference)

functions.name: set_measure_func
functions.brief:
Attach a custom measure function to this node.
The measure function is called by the layout engine to determine intrinsic
content size (e.g. for text or image elements). Not used by the default
flow/layout.lua but reserved for compatibility with future extensions.
functions.description:
Attach a custom measure function to this node.
The measure function is called by the layout engine to determine intrinsic
content size (e.g. for text or image elements). Not used by the default
flow/layout.lua but reserved for compatibility with future extensions.

functions.name: calculate_layout
functions.brief:
Run the layout engine on this node tree and store results in node.layout.
After calling this, use get_computed_* or get_layout() to read the results.
functions.description:
Run the layout engine on this node tree and store results in node.layout.
After calling this, use get_computed_* or get_layout() to read the results.

parameters.name: width
parameters.doc: Available width in pixels (falls back to numeric style.width or 0)

parameters.name: height
parameters.doc: Available height in pixels (falls back to numeric style.height or 0)

functions.name: get_layout
functions.brief: Return the full layout result table ({x, y, w, h}) after calculate_layout().
functions.description: Return the full layout result table ({x, y, w, h}) after calculate_layout().

returnvalues.doc: The computed layout, or nil if not yet calculated

functions.name: get_computed_top
functions.brief:
